lines.speaker: Chair
lines.text: Okay, next item: the pigeons on the market square. The traders keep complaining about droppings on their stalls.

lines.speaker: Operations
lines.text: We clean every morning, and by noon it's back. Honestly, I think it's time for a culling programme.

lines.speaker: Advisor
lines.text: Agreed. If we start in spring, the square is clean before the festival season. Nobody is going to miss a few hundred pigeons.

lines.speaker: Chair
lines.text: Right. So we remove them. Any objections?
